_comment: Urist (W2, Dwarf Fortress Archon) loads THIS file, not Project_Aion's, because his cwd
is Projects/DwarfCron. Every hook path below is ABSOLUTE on purpose: $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR
resolves to this satellite repo, which has no .claude/hooks of its own, so a relative
PostToolUse is NOT optional. Registering jicm-gate ONLY on UserPromptSubmit samples the
lane at prompt boundaries alone; a lane doing long tool-driven work then goes unsampled
between turns. Genie and Jacques ran that way for five days and Jacques went 0 -> 127K
in a single turn while JICM believed nothing had changed.
jicm-stop.sh in the Stop block is the SIGNAL RAISER. Without it, pending_action
HALT_AFTER_RESPONSE is written every turn and nothing ever acts on it — the lane senses
correctly and never cycles. That was Protos' defect, hiding behind the missing gate.
VERIFY BY BEHAVIOUR, NOT BY READING THIS FILE: a lane is registered when its gate log
shows PostToolUse samples > 0. Many prompt samples and zero tool samples means it is not.
Hook REGISTRATION is read at SESSION start, so a /clear is enough to pick it up; a running
